text:
Hannah L.: quick follow-up from the PM: recurring midnight DB connection surge. need: a compact playbook (triage cmds + immediate mitigations), owners, and short due dates so PM can close the loop.

Omar B.: i'll take the playbook edits. will add a 1-page triage checklist and safe commands. target PR in 5 business days.

Kait R.: i'll own automation hooks — small health endpoint + a CI smoke that runs nightly. plan: expose conn_util metric and a one-liner curl check. due 2024-07-01.

Nina T.: i'll map escalation steps and pager rules. suggestion: thresholds as code in runbook (makes syncing with alerts easier). examples: conn_util >75% for 10m => L2, >90% for 3m => L1 + exec page.

Hannah L.: include short rollback/mitigation steps for oncall — e.g., disable nightly job window, restart worker pool, and temporary throttle. keep commands copy/paste-safe.

Omar B.: initial triage snippet i'll add to the playbook:
```
# count active postgres connections
psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active';"
# check app errors for connection resets
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=api --since=5m | grep -i "connection"
# quick restart for worker if backlog high
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/worker --timeout=60s
```

deploy-bot: Created actions: PM-9910 (playbook triage), PM-9911 (health endpoint), PM-9912 (escalation map). Links: https://tracker.redwood/PM-9910

Kait R.: setting PM-9911 due 2024-07-01. will add a tiny PromQL for conn_util and link to alert.

Nina T.: setting PM-9912 due 2024-06-28. i'll include weekend phone fallback and exact pager text templates.

Omar B.: PM-9910 due 2024-06-24. will add a short test plan and hit list of commands for oncall runthrough.

Hannah L.: nice. i'll schedule a 20m runbook walk-through after PRs land and chase owners weekly. please tag PM-9910/9911/9912 in PRs. :thumbsup:

Kait R.: confirmed. i'll add the alert -> runbook mapping in the alert description as well.

Nina T.: confirmed. will run the walk-through with oncall and update the incident retro with links.

Omar B.: quick note: recurring root cause seems to be overlapping bulk jobs. propose separate action to stagger windows and add job-level backoff. opening PM-9913 and assigning to infra-dev leads.

Hannah L.: perfect. thanks team — weekly 15m sync until all actions resolved.
